answer_2.quote: Here we list some prominent automatic metrics: Image-Text Alignment. CLIP-Score ... Perceptual Distance. LPIPS ... Subject Fidelity. CLIP-I ... DINO metric ...

answer_3.quote: The function f can be any Multimodal Large Language Model (MLLM) such as and LLaVA, which can take input images to generate human-like text responses. Unlike the automatic metrics, MLLM can receive human instructions and produce rationale.

answer_4.quote: ImagenHub curated a human evaluation dataset for each task, in which the dataset contains around 100 to 200 conditional inputs for generating synthesized images. Then each image was rated by three human raters according to the guidelines of the defined task
answer_4.guideline: Images are rated in two aspects: (1) Semantic Consistency (SC) assesses how well the generated image aligns with the given conditions, such as prompts and subject tokens, ensuring coherence and relevance to the specified criteria according to the task. (2) Perceptual Quality (PQ) evaluates the extent to which the generated image appears visually authentic and conveys a sense of naturalness.
